line: "Discuss a current issue of importance to you…"
sub: …and how a Wharton education would help you explore it. 50–200 words. Pick an issue you've actually worked on, not a headline you read once.
Every applicant also writes a short thank-you note to someone they never thanked, and how they'd explore community at Penn. 50–200 words each.
A small business, a paid job, running a club's money, a stock pitch. One thing you built beats ten titles.
